name: Karkat Vantas
source:
One of the twelve trolls met in Pesterquest, and one of the first two met by the player alongside Kanaya in Volume 5.

Karkat is grouchy and prone to coming up with very creative insults, but he does care about his friends.

[spoiler]Karkat is secretly a mutant, and his blood color is the same as that of a human's.[/spoiler]
